name: Cedar Waxwing
desc: Cedar Waxwing (Bombycilla cedrorum): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The cedar waxwing is a member of the family Bombycillidae or waxwing family of passerine birds. It is a medium-sized bird that is mainly brown, gray, and yellow.
